Its #[cfg(test)] modules span lines 2465-2681, 2683-2816 and 2818-4545, which is 2079 lines, leaving about 2478 production lines (code_health::measure_source counts total lines minus cfg(test) module ranges). Better fix: split status.rs by responsibility (throughput/waste, planning cost/keep rule, the StatusView types) into modules, or re-scope this job to include that split.

summary: The refactor itself is correct. Athena::status is split into four helpers (class_forecasts, pending_with_resolutions, bootstrap_view, open_job_next_lines), each with a doc comment, and the moved code and the order of the next lines are the same as before. status is now 185 lines, so no function is over 200. The recorded fmt, clippy and test runs passed, and I ran the athena-core status tests: 49 passed. Only status.rs and the expected CHANGELOG.md changed. But the request asked for the file to be under its limits, and it isn't: status.rs has about 2478 production lines (4557 total minus 2079 lines of test modules), over the 2000-line file limit, and it was already about 2451 before the change. The request's 916-line figure is from a 26 October measurement, and the reading took it without checking. It also ruled out the module split that would fix the file. Code health will flag the file again after landing. Verdict: fail, because of that major finding and the reading mismatch. The fix is to re-scope this as a module split or land this as a partial step and queue the split.
